text: 80年的，43岁了。
en: Born in '80—I'm 43 now.

text: 上有将近70岁的父母公婆，下有19岁的儿子和14岁的女儿。
en: Above me are my parents and my husband's parents, nearly 70; below me, a 19-year-old son and a 14-year-old daughter.

text: 体会就是健康江河日下，熬不得夜，早上睡到五点就醒了，状况百出，小毛病不断。
en: My experience is that my health is on the decline—I can't stay up late, I wake at five in the morning, things keep going wrong, and minor ailments never stop.

text: 也许是前些年太拼，种下的苦果。
en: Perhaps it is the bitter fruit sown from pushing too hard in earlier years.

text: 体检表上面的各条，不是高了就是低了，没有一个是好的。
en: On the check-up sheet, every item is either too high or too low—not one is good.

text: 有多套房产，房租够生活；为了怕给亲人造成负担，给全家买了重疾险和大病险，各类保险齐全。
en: I own several properties; the rent covers living costs. Fearing I'd burden my family, I bought critical illness and major disease insurance for the whole family—every type of cover is in place.

text: 夫妻经营一个小公司，受疫情影响，生意有影响，但扣除给员工的工资社保外，还有盈余，不知道能坚持几年？
en: My husband and I run a small company. The pandemic affected business, but after deducting staff wages and social insurance there is still a surplus—who knows how many years it can last?

text: 又不知道这些老员工自由散漫，在我这呆了十几年，还能去哪？
en: And who knows where these old hands could go—they've drifted about here for over ten years, so free and undisciplined.

text: 又有谁能容忍他们迟到早退，上班打游戏，吃早餐，刷剧？
en: And who else would tolerate their lateness, leaving early, playing games at work, eating breakfast, binge-watching shows?

text: 年终还能拿万把料的年终奖？
en: Or still get a year-end bonus of around ten thousand?

text: 父母公婆身体还好，但也是需要照顾的年龄了。
en: My parents and parents-in-law are still fairly healthy, but they have reached the age where they need looking after.

text: 四人三人没有医保，我给他们买了养老和农保。
en: Of the four, three have no medical cover, so I bought them pension and rural insurance.

text: 每人每月两千多，在农村够吃用。
en: Over two thousand each a month—enough to live on in the countryside.

text: 但是，小问题总有。
en: But minor problems are always cropping up.

text: 公公的尿结石，高血脂，婆婆种植牙糖尿病，爸爸中风，妈妈的心脏病。
en: My father-in-law's urinary stones and high blood lipids, my mother-in-law's dental implants and diabetes, my father's stroke, my mother's heart disease.

text: 每个月月初，都在给他们买药，怕他们药吃完了。
en: At the start of every month I'm buying medicine for them, afraid they'll run out.

text: 我自己物质欲望极低，已经两三年没有买过一件衣服了，化妆品也好久不用，前天一看，都过期了，也不打算买了，不是没钱节约啥的，就是不想买。
en: My own material desires are very low—I haven't bought a single item of clothing in two or three years, and I've not used cosmetics for ages; the other day I looked and they'd all expired, and I don't plan to buy more. It's not about saving money—I just don't want to buy.

text: 儿子明年读大学，以后的路就靠他自己了，我给他在市区买了房子，在外面混不下去就回家吧，父母总是他永远的靠山。
en: My son starts university next year; from then on his path is his own. I bought him a flat in the city centre—if he can't make it out there, he can come home. Parents are always his permanent support.

text: 老二，目前看，普高是可以考牢的，她想读什么专业都随意吧。
en: The second child, as things stand, should manage to get into a regular senior high school; whatever subject she wants to study is up to her.

text: 儿女的事情，不想瞎操心。
en: I don't want to fuss needlessly over my children's affairs.

text: 中年的愿望，就是希望全家健康，孩子懂事上进，健康快乐吧
en: My wish in middle age is simply that the whole family stays healthy, the children are sensible and ambitious, healthy and happy.

text: 1、绝大部分的穷人，要比富人的认知至少晚20年，很多穷人35、40岁才认清这个世界，而富人15岁就认识了，更有甚者，一辈子都认不清的大有人在。
en: 1. The vast majority of poor people are at least twenty years behind the rich in awareness. Many poor only come to see the world clearly at 35 or 40, while the rich understand it at 15—and there are plenty who never see it clearly in their whole lives.

text: 穷人的身边，这种人很多，不信，你自己去看看。
en: Around the poor there are many such people. If you don't believe it, go and see for yourself.

text: 2、强者不需要很多弱者朋友，他只和能付给他钱的人、帮他赚钱的人、比他厉害的人交朋友。
en: 2. The strong don't need many weak friends; they only befriend those who pay them, those who help them make money, and those stronger than themselves.

text: 慢慢开始利用规则，为己所用。
en: They gradually begin to use the rules for their own benefit.

text: 知道如何处理人情，给予人情，可也没什么感情。
en: They know how to handle and grant favours, yet feel little real affection.

text: 3、人这辈子别太把自己当回事了，名气这玩意，是优势也是劣势。
en: 3. In this life, don't take yourself too seriously. Fame is a thing that is both an advantage and a disadvantage.

text: 你看那么多明星，没红的时候发微博都很有趣，一红了微博啥也不敢讲。
en: Look at all those celebrities: before they got famous their Weibo posts were fun, but once famous they daren't say a thing.

text: 4、zg的教育都是洗脑填鸭式的，没有独立思考的能力，出了社会吃过亏才知道原来的观念都是错的，才能认清社会的本质。
en: 4. China's education is all brainwashing and rote-feeding; it leaves no capacity for independent thought. Only after entering society and taking knocks do people realise their old notions were wrong, and only then can they see the true nature of society.

text: 越是穷人的家庭越是这样，因为穷人的孩子只接受学校的教育，家长本身视野和能力有限，也没有时间或没有能力教育孩子。
en: The poorer the family, the more this holds true, because poor children receive only the school's education; the parents themselves have limited horizons and ability, and no time or capacity to educate their children.

text: 5、记住这三条能量定律：
en: 5. Remember these three laws of energy:

text: 1、能量比你低的人
en: 1. Those whose energy is lower than yours

text: 怀疑你、否定你、评判你、嫉妒你、攻击你、消耗你。
en: doubt you, deny you, judge you, envy you, attack you, drain you.

text: 2、能量同频的人
en: 2. Those at the same frequency as you

text: 喜欢你、肯定你、欣赏你、陪伴你、珍惜你。
en: like you, affirm you, appreciate you, keep you company, cherish you.

text: 3、能量比你高的人
en: 3. Those whose energy is higher than yours

text: 理解你、包容你、守护你、扶持你、成就你、让你打怪升级。
en: understand you, tolerate you, guard you, support you, fulfil you, and let you fight monsters and level up.

text: 6、一个人的生命质量，就等于这个人的认知质量，并且一分一毫都不会差。
en: 6. A person's quality of life equals the quality of that person's awareness, down to the very last fraction.

text: 所有的富人，都是给社会提供价值的人，都是内心有爱的人。
en: All rich people are those who provide value to society, and all are people with love in their hearts.

text: 富人提供了工作岗位，提供了产品，提供了服务。
en: The rich provide jobs, provide products, provide services.

text: 所以他们赚钱真的很简单，你只要给别人提供这些东西就完事了。
en: So making money is truly simple for them—you just provide these things for others and that's it.

text: 你给别人提供的价值越高，别人给你的钱就会越多。
en: The more value you provide to others, the more money they give you.

text: 如果你不能给别人提供价值，那你就只能一辈子做一个穷人。
en: If you can't provide value to others, then you can only be a poor person all your life.

text: 穷人贪婪，喜欢白嫖，所以他们永远赚不到一分钱，只能苦哈哈打工
en: The poor are greedy and love a free ride, so they never earn a single penny and can only toil miserably as wage workers.

text: 7、废物看人都是看人品，他人品好，他人品不好。
en: 7. Good-for-nothings size people up by character—'his character is good, his character is bad'.

text: 强者看人都是看需求。
en: The strong size people up by need.

text: 看一下对方有什么功能可以被我利用。
en: They look at what use the other party can be put to.

text: 郭德纲人品咋样跟我有啥关系？
en: What does Degang Guo's character have to do with me?

text: 他讲的相声能逗我乐就行了。
en: As long as the crosstalk he performs makes me laugh, that's enough.

text: 你老公出不出轨跟你有啥关系？
en: What does your husband's cheating have to do with you?

text: 他每个月能给你打两万块钱就行了。
en: As long as he transfers twenty thousand yuan to you each month, that's enough.

text: 你没发现从需求来看人，整个世界都变得通畅了吗？
en: Haven't you noticed that looking at people through need makes the whole world become smooth and clear?

text: 8、富人的孩子从小周围的商业氛围很浓，从小耳濡目染。
en: 8. The children of the rich grow up steeped in a strong business atmosphere from an early age, absorbing it by osmosis.

text: 所以就算是个石头脑袋，长大了商业方面的智慧也比山沟沟里出来的天才厉害的多。
en: So even a stone-headed dullard, once grown, has far more business wisdom than a genius from some backwater gully.

text: 所以，富人家的孩子创业成功率是很高的。
en: Thus the children of the rich have a very high rate of entrepreneurial success.

text: 9、很多人都拎不清，家庭的核心不是感情，而是经济。
en: 9. Many people fail to see it clearly: the core of a family is not affection but economy.

text: 当你的钱还不太够用时，你完全不需要太在意夫妻情情 ，娘家人的感情，亲人感情。
en: When your money isn't quite enough, you needn't care too much about marital affection, your natal family's feelings, or relatives' affection.

text: 你只需要玩命做好事业。
en: You only need to throw yourself into your career.

text: 同样的，当你周围的人全都是穷人的时候，自然就会感觉到没有一个婚姻是幸福的。
en: Likewise, when everyone around you is poor, you naturally feel that not a single marriage is happy.

text: 要知道，贫贱夫妻百事哀。
en: You should know: poor and lowly couples grieve over every little thing.

text: 爱情？
en: Love?

text: 幸福婚姻？
en: A happy marriage?

text: 不存在的。
en: Doesn't exist.

text: 那是上等人才配有的东西，穷人只配拼命搞钱。
en: That is something only the upper class deserve; the poor only deserve to scramble desperately for money.

text: 10、身边的穷人永远教不会你任何道理。
en: 10. The poor around you can never teach you any truth.

text: 如果有，那么只有一条，便是远离穷人。
en: If there is one, it is only this: stay away from the poor.

text: 不然他们的穷气、恶气、毒气、戾气，会360度全方位无死角地把你给侵袭。
en: Otherwise their poverty-stink, malice, poison and ferocity will invade you from every angle, 360 degrees, with no blind spot.

text: 11、思想成熟的男人都明白，任何人的底气都来源于经济实力，如果你难过的时候连酒都买不起，那你连难过的资格都没有。
en: 11. Mentally mature men all understand that anyone's confidence comes from economic strength. If when you're sad you can't even afford a drink, then you don't even have the qualification to be sad.

text: 12、穷人，孩子刚打工，就逼着给家里打钱，食骨吸髓，恨不得生吞活剥了。
en: 12. The poor, the moment their child starts working, force them to send money home, sucking the marrow from their bones, all but devouring them alive.

text: 穷人，最喜欢给孩子讲孝道。
en: The poor most love to preach filial piety to their children.

text: 穷人，会不择手段，把孩子留在自己身边。
en: The poor will use any means to keep their children by their side.

text: 穷人，最喜欢说儿孙自有儿孙福。
en: The poor most love to say 'sons and grandsons have their own blessings'.

text: 13、底层的婚姻，为了生存互相抱团，是必需品，一定要有。
en: 13. Marriages at the bottom, formed for survival by huddling together, are a necessity—they must exist.

text: 中层的婚姻为了发展，1+1>2，可有可无。
en: Middle-class marriages exist for advancement, 1+1>2; they are optional.

text: 上层的婚姻，为了利益，资源整合，是奢侈品，可以没有。
en: Upper-class marriages exist for interest and resource integration; they are a luxury and may be absent.

text: 一个男人在没有事业和金钱之前，什么都可以切掉，包括爱情。
en: Before a man has a career and money, he can cut away everything, including love.

text: 毕竟这个社会对男人成功的评判标准不是有钱就是有权？
en: After all, isn't this society's measure of a man's success either money or power?

text: 有谁说一个男人靠感情赢得战争的吗？
en: Has anyone ever said a man wins a war through feelings?

text: 当年我努力把自己变得温柔，变得体贴，变得善解人意，但是呢，我发现我想要的一切离我越来越远，到头来，我才发现，我什么都不需要，我有钱就够了。
en: Back then I strove to make myself gentle, considerate, understanding; but I found everything I wanted drifting further away. In the end I realised I need nothing at all—having money is enough.

text: 有钱，一切问题都解决了。
en: With money, every problem is solved.

text: 有人说，我一生没做过坏事，为什么会混成这个逼样。
en: Someone said, 'I've never done a bad deed in my life, so why have I ended up in such a wretched state.'

text: 我说，你穷，就已经是犯罪了。
en: I said, your poverty is itself already a crime.

text: 你穷，你就已经是得罪人了
en: You are poor, so you have already offended people.
